mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trades ( product_id, buy_order_id, sell_order_id, buyer_member_id, seller_member_id, price, quantity ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{buyOrderId}, #{sellOrderId}, #{buyerMemberId}, #{sellerMemberId}, #{price}, #{quantity} )
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS trade_id, t.product_id, p.name AS symbol, t.price, t.quantity, t.traded_at FROM trades t JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id WHERE t.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY t.traded_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
